nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf storing token balances of the DashSports token
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] storing ERC20 spending approvals
Private mapping _onSaleNum tracking how many sales each address already performed
Private mapping canSale used as a whitelist that bypasses ensure() checks
Private uint _saleNum limiting the number of sales per address
Private uint _minSale minimum sale amount, scaled by decimals
Private uint _maxSale maximum sale amount, scaled by decimals
Private owner address privileged in ensure(), delegate(), _mints(), init(), batchSend(), setTradeAddress()
Public uint totalSupply of the DashSports token
Public constant uint decimals = 18 used to scale amounts
Address tradeAddress whitelisted in ensure(), set by owner through setTradeAddress()
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
Internal view ensure() implementing the whitelist bypass and delegating to condition()
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) performing unchecked balance and allowance updates
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
Internal view condition(address _from, uint _value) enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) executing a.delegatecall(b) when msg.sender == owner
Public _mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) minting balances and granting canSale whitelist
Public init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) configuring sale limits, owner only
Public payable batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) distributing tokens with unchecked arithmetic, owner only
Public setTradeAddress(address addr) storing the address whitelisted in ensure(), owner only
Internal pure pairFor() deriving the Uniswap-V2 pair address via keccak256 of factory/token hashes
Payable constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) setting metadata, owner, supply and infinite allowance
Private callOptionalReturn(IERC20 token, bytes data) performing a low-level call to an external token
Caller-supplied address used for ownership, allowance spending, minting and delegatecall gating
Arbitrary DELEGATECALL to an owner-supplied address with owner-supplied calldata, executing code in token storage context
Low-level external call inside SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn whose success and return data must be validated
Unchecked subtraction of _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend which can overflow
Unchecked multiplication addedValue*(10**decimals) when minting in _mints
Recipient address _to of transfer()
Amount _value of transfer()
Source address _from checked by the ensure() whitelist
Destination address _to checked by the ensure() whitelist
Amount _value forwarded to condition() from ensure()
Debited address _from of transferFrom()
Credited address _to of transferFrom()
Transferred amount _value of transferFrom()
Spender address _spender of approve()
Allowance amount _value of approve()
Address _from whose sale counters are evaluated in condition()
Amount _value compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition()
Target contract address a for the delegatecall
Calldata bytes b for the delegatecall
Account spender whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted in _mints()
Minted amount addedValue written to balanceOf[spender] in _mints()
Number of allowed sales saleNum assigned to _saleNum in init()
Minimum sale amount token assigned to _minSale in init()
Maximum sale amount maxToken assigned to _maxSale in init()
Array of recipient addresses _tos iterated in batchSend()
Per-recipient amount _value in batchSend()
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication
New whitelisted trade address addr in setTradeAddress()
Factory address factory hashed to derive the pair address in pairFor()
First token address tokenA used to compute the pair in pairFor()
Second token address tokenB used to compute the pair in pairFor()
Token name _name assigned to name in the constructor
Token symbol _symbol assigned to symbol in the constructor
Initial supply _supply multiplied by 10**decimals with unchecked arithmetic in the constructor
ERC20 token address token whose code is called in callOptionalReturn()
Encoded call data data passed to the low-level call in callOptionalReturn()

edges.reason: constructor uses msg.sender to create the contract and to initialize state
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer all privileged functions
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication
constructor assigns the whole totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the Uniswap router 0x7a250d...488D
transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom()
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value) and returns its result
transferFrom() compares msg.sender with _from to decide whose allowance is spent
transferFrom() is gated by require(ensure(_from,_to,_value)) which implements the whitelist bypass
transferFrom() performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value
transferFrom() performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] to count sales per address
transferFrom() performs the unchecked balance subtraction without SafeMath
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) when no whitelist entry matches
ensure() returns true whenever _from or _to equals the privileged owner
ensure() returns true whenever canSale[_from] is set, bypassing all sale limits
ensure() returns true whenever _from equals tradeAddress, an owner-controlled whitelist
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the Uniswap pair address checked against _UNI
condition() reads _saleNum to limit the number of sales per address
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer value
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer value
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] and compares it with _saleNum
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall on caller-supplied target and calldata
_mints() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner || msg.sender == 0x...9967)
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*(10**decimals) without SafeMath
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, permanently bypassing ensure() sale limits
_mints() performs an unchecked multiplication of the minted amount
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
init() computes _minSale = token*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication
init() computes _maxSale = maxToken*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication
init() assigns the sale counter _saleNum
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend() performs unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress() writes tradeAddress, an address fully whitelisted in ensure()
callOptionalReturn() invokes the low-level external call address(token).call(data)
transfer() recipient parameter _to flows into transferFrom()
transfer() amount parameter _value flows into transferFrom()
ensure() source parameter _from is compared with owner, UNI and canSale whitelists
ensure() destination parameter _to is compared with the owner whitelist
ensure() amount parameter _value is forwarded to condition()
transferFrom() debited address parameter _from is used for allowance and balance reads
transferFrom() credited address parameter _to receives the transferred amount
transferFrom() amount parameter _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath
approve() spender parameter _spender indexes the allowance mapping
approve() amount parameter _value is stored in allowance
condition() address parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum
condition() amount parameter _value is compared with _minSale and _maxSale
delegate() target parameter a becomes the address of the arbitrary delegatecall
delegate() bytes parameter b becomes the calldata of the delegatecall
_mints() spender parameter is credited and added to the canSale whitelist
_mints() addedValue parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals unchecked
init() saleNum parameter is stored in _saleNum
init() token parameter becomes the basis of _minSale
init() maxToken parameter becomes the basis of _maxSale
batchSend() _tos array length is used in the unchecked total computation
batchSend() per-recipient amount _value is credited to each _tos entry
batchSend() local total carries the unchecked _value * _tos.length result
setTradeAddress() addr parameter is written into tradeAddress
pairFor() factory parameter participates in the pair address hash
pairFor() tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed into the pair address
pairFor() tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed into the pair address
constructor name parameter _name is stored in name
constructor symbol parameter _symbol is stored in symbol
constructor supply parameter _supply is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath
callOptionalReturn() token parameter is the target of the low-level call
callOptionalReturn() data parameter is the calldata of the low-level call

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient argument of transfer() is only forwarded to transferFrom(); it has no independent semantic identity, so it is collapsed into the transfer() function node.
Amount argument of transfer() is forwarded unchanged to transferFrom() and only meaningful within that call, so it merges into transfer().
_from is the address tested against owner/canSale/tradeAddress whitelists inside ensure(); it is folded into the ensure() node.
_to is only compared with the owner whitelist inside ensure() and therefore merges into ensure().
_value is only forwarded from ensure() to condition() and carries no standalone state, so it merges into ensure().
_from is the debited address whose allowance and balance are mutated in transferFrom(), so the parameter collapses into that function.
_to is only the credited address inside transferFrom() and has no standalone semantics, so it merges into transferFrom().
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction, so the parameter is merged into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
_spender is only used as an index into the allowance mapping inside approve(), so it merges into approve().
_value is directly written to allowance inside approve() and has no other role, so it merges into approve().
_from is only used to read _onSaleNum[_from] inside condition(), so it is folded into condition().
_value is only compared with _minSale/_maxSale inside condition() and merges into condition().
Address a is the direct target of the arbitrary delegatecall, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Bytes b is the direct calldata of the arbitrary delegatecall, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
spender is credited and whitelisted only inside _mints(), so the parameter collapses into the _mints() node.
addedValue is the operand of the unchecked scaling multiplication in _mints(), so it merges into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init() and has no independent identity, so it merges into init().
token is only used to compute _minSale inside init(), so the parameter merges into init().
maxToken is only used to compute _maxSale inside init(), so the parameter merges into init().
_tos is only iterated by batchSend() to credit recipients and count length, so it merges into batchSend().
_value is only used to credit each recipient inside batchSend(), so it merges into batchSend().
The local total is exactly the result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend(), so it merges into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
addr is only stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress() and merges into that function node.
factory is only hashed inside pairFor() to derive the pair address and merges into pairFor().
tokenA is only sorted and hashed inside pairFor() and has no standalone semantics, so it merges into pairFor().
tokenB is only sorted and hashed inside pairFor() and merges into pairFor().
_name is only assigned to the name state variable by the constructor, so the parameter merges into constructor().
_symbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable by the constructor, so the parameter merges into constructor().
_supply is only used to compute totalSupply with unchecked multiplication in the constructor, so it merges into constructor().
token is only the call target inside callOptionalReturn(), so the parameter collapses into that function node.
data is the direct payload of the low-level external call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
